newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-SURPRISE 1996 FINALISTS FAIL TO REACH FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SURPRISE 1996 FINALISTS FAIL TO REACH FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Third division giant-killers Nimes, finalists last season, have failed to reach the first round of the French Cup.
"It's the end of a love affair between Nimes and the French Cup," coach Pierre Mosca said after his side lost 1-0 away to second division Toulouse in a preliminary round match on Sunday.
"My players would have had their chance if the match had been played as (originally) scheduled at the Costieres stadium."
Nimes, who reached the second round of the European Cup Winners' Cup this season, relinquished home advantage when the freezing weather made their pitch unplayable.
They have not, however, lost hope of more giant-killing. They meet first division Montpellier in the last 16 of the League Cup on Friday.
